name: agent-eval-foundry
description: Measure how many independent things a benchmark suite actually measures, given the bank of subjects it was graded against.

scripts.report: node dist/cli.js report examples/durable-outbox/matrix.json --out reports/durable-outbox-axis-report.md && node dist/cli.js report --import swebench --null-trials 3 examples/public-swebench-verified/swebench-verified.raw.json --out reports/public-swebench-verified-axis-report.md
scripts.verify: node dist/cli.js report examples/durable-outbox/matrix.json > /tmp/axis-a.md && diff -u reports/durable-outbox-axis-report.md /tmp/axis-a.md && node dist/cli.js report --import swebench --null-trials 3 examples/public-swebench-verified/swebench-verified.raw.json > /tmp/axis-b.md && diff -u reports/public-swebench-verified-axis-report.md /tmp/axis-b.md && echo 'both reports reproducible'
